cached_image.title: Cached Image
cached_image.description: Caches Spotify image URLs for artists/tracks to avoid redundant API queries and improve load speed

id.description: Name or Spotify ID of the entity

favorite_map.title: Favorite Map
favorite_map.description: A saved constellation map representing a user's favorite song or artist DNA

userId.description: The UID of the user who saved this constellation

name.description: Name of the central track or artist

artist.description: Artist of the central track (if map type is song, empty for artist map)

genres.description: List of genres associated with this central node

description.description: Explanatory text of the central node style or acoustic metrics

nodes.description: Array of connected ConnectionNode or ArtistConnectionNode constellations

/cached_images/{imageId}.description: Globally shared collection of cached artist and track images

/users/{userId}/favorites/{favoriteId}.description: Strictly sub-collected personal favorite music maps for each user
